```php
<?php

namespace App\Policies;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\HandlesAuthorization;

class UserPolicy
{
    use HandlesAuthorization;

    public function viewAny(User $user)
    {
        return true; // Allow all users to view any user
    }

    public function view(User $user, User $model)
    {
        return true; // Allow the current user to view a specific user
    }

    public function create(User $user)
    {
        return false; // Only allow an admin to create users
    }

    public function update(User $user, User $model)
    {
        return $user->is_admin || ($user->id === $model->id); // Admins can update their own user and others if they're the same
    }

    public function delete(User $user, User $model)
    {
        return $user->is_admin; // Only allow an admin to delete a user
    }
}
```
